اقتصرن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَرْنَ (iqtaṣarna) /iq.ta.sˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اُقْتُصِرْنَ (uqtuṣirna) /uq.tu.sˤir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اِقْتَصِرْنَ (iqtaṣirna) /iq.ta.sˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
